turns.text: Cocoa sounds like a cozy way to start a Sunday, even with the Phoenix summer heat outside! Do you have a night shift at the ER later, or are you off?

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a perfect, low-key Sunday. How have you been feeling lately, by the way? Are you completely back to normal after that bout of flu?

turns.text: Oh yeah, I'm feeling 100% now. My energy is totally back, which is great because Tom and I actually went out salsa dancing on Friday night.

turns.text: It was so much fun! The venue was pretty crowded, but we still had a blast. It felt so good to just move and not think about work for a while.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: I'm so glad to hear you had such a great time and are feeling completely healthy again. Enjoy the rest of your relaxing, commute-free Sunday with Tom!

turns.speaker: user
